svg.title: 90-day daily project commits — square-root scale
svg.desc: Window 2026-07-16 to 2026-10-13. Square-root vertical scale, raw-count tick labels, all 90 daily bars, trailing 7-calendar-day arithmetic mean with available-day warm-up; no counts capped or dropped. Peak 711 on 2026-09-12. All authors except bots, project-wide, not personal contributions.
svg.text: Every day, at its real scale.
Square-root axis · ticks show raw counts
Mean: up to 7 available days at window start.
